risk: Restore-test worker can overwrite existing logical DB/Auth/Storage. Target contains user accounts and thousands of Storage objects and is the independent continuity replica.
required_before_rehearsal: Allocate a distinct empty disposable Supabase target or an explicitly approved empty isolated environment with authentic Supabase Auth/Storage/Edge.
Record source and target refs, DB-project binding and exact asset hash inventory.
Keep the existing replica and Development protected while establishing a third environment.
Obtain current-schema off-site backup and verify bytes/keys independently.
Only then run a restore test with measured RPO/RTO and 14 post-restore gates.
